exercises.name: 180-Degree Jump
exercises.description: Jump and rotate 180 degrees in the air, then land balanced and controlled.

exercises.name: 45-Degree Back Extension
exercises.description: Set hips on 45-degree bench. Lower torso, then raise by extending hips and squeezing glutes.

exercises.name: 90/90 Hip Switch
exercises.description: Sit in 90/90 hip position and rotate knees side to side with control.

exercises.name: Ab Wheel Rollout
exercises.description: Kneel with ab wheel under shoulders. Roll forward while bracing, then pull back to start.

exercises.name: Adductor Rock Back
exercises.description: Start on hands and knees with one leg extended to side. Rock hips back and forward slowly.

exercises.name: Advanced Tuck Front Lever Hold
exercises.description: Hold a front lever progression with knees tucked and hips opened farther from the body.

exercises.name: Advanced Tuck Planche Hold
exercises.description: Hold a planche progression with knees tucked but hips extended farther behind the body.

exercises.name: Ankle Dorsiflexion Mobilization
exercises.description: Kneel with one foot forward and drive knee over toes while heel stays down.

exercises.name: Archer Pull-Up
exercises.description: Pull toward one hand while the opposite arm assists in a straighter position.

exercises.name: Archer Push Up
exercises.description: Use a wide hand position. Shift weight toward one arm as the opposite arm stays straighter, then alternate.

exercises.name: Arm Circles
exercises.description: Extend arms and make controlled circles forward and backward to warm shoulders.

exercises.name: Arm-Over-Arm Sled Pull
exercises.description: Pull a sled toward you hand-over-hand using a rope.

exercises.name: Arnold Press
exercises.description: Start with dumbbells at shoulder level, palms facing you. Rotate wrists outward while pressing overhead. Reverse motion on descent.

exercises.name: Assisted Pull Up
exercises.description: Use an assisted pull-up machine or band. Pull chest toward bar, then lower with control.

exercises.name: Atlas Stone Load
exercises.description: Lift a stone from the floor and load it to a platform using hips, back, and arms.

exercises.name: Atlas Stone to Shoulder
exercises.description: Lift a stone from the floor and bring it to one shoulder with full-body tension.

exercises.name: Axle Clean and Press
exercises.description: Clean a thick axle bar to the shoulders and press it overhead.

exercises.name: Axle Deadlift
exercises.description: Deadlift a thick axle bar from the floor while maintaining grip and trunk tension.

exercises.name: Back Extension
exercises.description: Anchor hips in back extension bench. Lower torso, then extend hips to raise body in line.

exercises.name: Back Lever Hold
exercises.description: Hold a straight-body back lever with arms extended and body parallel to the floor.

exercises.name: Back Squat (High Bar)
exercises.description: Place bar high on traps. Squat down with upright torso, then drive through feet to stand.

exercises.name: Back Squat (Low Bar)
exercises.description: Place bar lower across rear delts. Sit hips back and down, then drive up through midfoot.

exercises.name: Backward Sled Drag
exercises.description: Walk backward while dragging a sled to emphasize knee extension and quad endurance.

exercises.name: Band External Rotation
exercises.description: Anchor a band at elbow height. Rotate forearm outward while keeping elbow at the side.

exercises.name: Band Pull-Apart
exercises.description: Hold band at shoulder height. Pull band apart until hands move out to sides, then return slowly.

exercises.name: Band Shoulder Dislocates
exercises.description: Hold a band wide and move arms from front to overhead and behind, then return.

exercises.name: Banded Clamshell
exercises.description: Lie on side with knees bent and band above knees. Open top knee, pause, then lower.

exercises.name: Banded Lateral Walk
exercises.description: Place resistance band around legs. Step sideways with controlled tension, keeping knees slightly bent.

exercises.name: Bar Muscle-Up
exercises.description: Pull explosively over a straight bar and press to support with controlled turnover.

exercises.name: Barbell Glute Bridge
exercises.description: Lie on floor with bar over hips. Drive hips upward, squeeze glutes, then lower to floor.

exercises.name: Barbell Shrug
exercises.description: Hold bar in front of thighs. Elevate shoulders straight up, pause, then lower.

exercises.name: Battle Ropes
exercises.description: Hold rope ends and create waves, slams, or alternating pulses while bracing core.

exercises.name: Bear Crawl
exercises.description: Move forward on hands and feet with knees close to floor. Keep hips low and core braced.

exercises.name: Belt Squat
exercises.description: Attach belt to loading point. Squat while torso stays upright, then stand through midfoot.

exercises.name: Bench Dip
exercises.description: Place hands on a bench behind hips. Lower by bending elbows, then press back up.

exercises.name: Bench Press (Barbell)
exercises.description: Lie on bench with feet flat. Lower bar to chest with control, press up explosively. Keep core tight and shoulder blades retracted.

exercises.name: Bench Press (Dumbbell)
exercises.description: Lie on a flat bench holding dumbbells at chest level. Press up until arms are extended, then lower with control.

exercises.name: Bench Press (Smith Machine)
exercises.description: Lie under a Smith machine bar. Unrack, lower bar to mid-chest, then press upward while keeping shoulder blades set.

exercises.name: Bent Over Row (Barbell)
exercises.description: Hinge at hips, back straight. Pull bar to lower chest/upper abdomen, squeeze shoulder blades. Lower with control.

exercises.name: Bicep Curl (Barbell/Dumbbell)
exercises.description: Stand holding weights at sides. Curl weights to shoulders, squeeze biceps at top. Lower with control, avoid swinging.

exercises.name: Bicycle Crunch
exercises.description: Lie on back and alternate bringing elbow toward opposite knee while extending other leg.

exercises.name: Bird Dog
exercises.description: Start on all fours. Extend opposite arm and leg, pause, then return and alternate.

exercises.name: Box Jump
exercises.description: Stand facing a box. Jump onto it with soft landing, step down, and repeat.

exercises.name: Box Jump Over
exercises.description: Jump onto or over a box and land with control before resetting or cycling reps.

exercises.name: Box Squat
exercises.description: Squat back to a box or bench, lightly pause, then drive up to standing.

exercises.name: Broad Jump
exercises.description: Jump forward for distance and land with knees tracking and hips controlled.

exercises.name: Bulgarian Split Squat
exercises.description: Rear foot elevated on bench. Lower front leg until thigh parallel, drive through front heel to stand. Unilateral movement.

exercises.name: Burpee
exercises.description: Drop to floor, kick feet back, perform push-up if desired, jump feet in, and stand or jump.

exercises.name: Burpee Broad Jump
exercises.description: Perform a burpee, then jump forward for distance before resetting.

exercises.name: Butterfly Stretch
exercises.description: Sit with soles of feet together. Let knees fall outward and gently hinge forward.

exercises.name: Cable Crunch
exercises.description: Kneel facing high cable with rope. Crunch ribs toward pelvis, then return with control.

exercises.name: Cable Curl
exercises.description: Stand facing low cable. Curl handle or bar toward shoulders while keeping elbows near sides.

exercises.name: Cable External Rotation
exercises.description: Stand beside a cable with elbow bent at 90 degrees. Rotate forearm outward while keeping elbow tucked.

exercises.name: Cable Fly
exercises.description: Stand between cable handles. Sweep arms together in a wide arc while keeping a soft elbow bend.

exercises.name: Cable Glute Kickback
exercises.description: Attach ankle strap to low cable. Kick leg backward while keeping torso stable, then return.

exercises.name: Cable Hip Abduction
exercises.description: Attach ankle strap to low cable. Move leg out to side, pause, then return with control.

exercises.name: Cable Hip Adduction
exercises.description: Attach ankle strap to low cable. Sweep leg inward across body, then return slowly.

exercises.name: Cable Lateral Raise
exercises.description: Stand beside a low cable. Raise handle out to side to shoulder height, then lower slowly.

exercises.name: Cable Overhead Tricep Extension
exercises.description: Face away from high cable with rope overhead. Extend elbows forward/up, then bend with control.

exercises.name: Cable Pull Through
exercises.description: Face away from low cable holding rope between legs. Hinge back, then drive hips forward.

exercises.name: Cable Pullover
exercises.description: Use a high cable or rope. Sweep arms down and back without bending elbows much.

exercises.name: Cable Rear Delt Fly
exercises.description: Set cables at shoulder height. Pull handles outward and back with soft elbows.

exercises.name: Cable Tricep Kickback
exercises.description: Set cable low. Hinge forward and extend elbow backward against cable resistance.

exercises.name: Cable Woodchop
exercises.description: Set cable high or low. Rotate torso and pull handle diagonally across body, then return slowly.

exercises.name: Calf Raise
exercises.description: Stand on balls of feet, raise heels as high as possible. Lower slowly to full stretch. Can use bodyweight or added weight.

exercises.name: Calf Wall Stretch
exercises.description: Place hands on wall, step one foot back, keep heel down, and lean forward.

exercises.name: Captain Chair Knee Raise
exercises.description: Support body on captain chair pads. Raise knees toward chest, then lower with control.

exercises.name: Car Deadlift
exercises.description: Deadlift a car-deadlift frame or lever implement from handles at the sides.

exercises.name: Cat-Cow Stretch
exercises.description: On hands and knees, alternate arching and rounding the spine slowly.

exercises.name: Chest-Supported Row (Dumbbell)
exercises.description: Lie chest-down on an incline bench. Row dumbbells toward ribs, squeeze shoulder blades, and lower.

exercises.name: Chest-to-Bar Pull-Up
exercises.description: Pull until the chest contacts or reaches the bar, then lower with control.

exercises.name: Child's Pose
exercises.description: Kneel and sit hips back toward heels while reaching arms forward and relaxing torso.

exercises.name: Chin Up (Supinated)
exercises.description: Underhand grip, hands shoulder-width. Pull up emphasizing biceps and lats. Lower with control to full arm extension.

exercises.name: Circus Dumbbell Press
exercises.description: Clean a large dumbbell to the shoulder and press it overhead with one arm.

exercises.name: Clapping Push-Up
exercises.description: Perform an explosive push-up and clap before returning hands to the floor.

exercises.name: Clean and Press
exercises.description: Clean weight to shoulders, then press overhead and return with control.

exercises.name: Close-Grip Bench Press
exercises.description: Grip bar slightly narrower than shoulder width. Lower to lower chest and press up, emphasizing triceps.

exercises.name: Close-Grip Lat Pulldown
exercises.description: Use close or neutral grip handle. Pull toward upper chest, squeeze lats, then return with control.

exercises.name: Cobra Stretch
exercises.description: Lie face-down, place hands under shoulders, and gently lift chest to extend spine.

exercises.name: Commando Pull Up
exercises.description: Grip bar with hands facing each other on opposite sides. Pull head to one side of bar, alternating sides.

exercises.name: Conan’s Wheel
exercises.description: Carry a front-loaded implement in the crooks of the elbows while walking in a circle.

exercises.name: Concentration Curl
exercises.description: Sit with elbow braced against inner thigh. Curl dumbbell up, then lower slowly.

exercises.name: Cone Hop
exercises.description: Hop over a cone forward, backward, or laterally with quick foot contacts.

exercises.name: Cossack Squat
exercises.description: Wide stance, shift weight to one side while keeping other leg straight. Lower into deep squat, return to center, alternate sides.

exercises.name: Couch Stretch
exercises.description: Place back foot on wall or bench in kneeling lunge. Tuck pelvis and hold quad/hip flexor stretch.

exercises.name: Countermovement Jump
exercises.description: Dip quickly and jump vertically using an explosive countermovement.

exercises.name: Cross-Body Shoulder Stretch
exercises.description: Pull one arm across chest with opposite arm until rear shoulder stretches.

exercises.name: Crucifix Hold
exercises.description: Hold weights out to the sides at shoulder height for time.

exercises.name: Crunch
exercises.description: Lie on back with knees bent. Curl shoulders off floor using abs, then lower slowly.

exercises.name: Cuban Press
exercises.description: Raise elbows high, externally rotate shoulders, then press lightly overhead and reverse.

exercises.name: Curtsy Lunge
exercises.description: Step one leg diagonally behind the other. Lower into a lunge, then return to standing.

exercises.name: Dead Bug
exercises.description: Lie on back with arms and knees up. Extend opposite arm and leg while keeping lower back down.

exercises.name: Dead Hang
exercises.description: Hang from pull-up bar with arms straight. Keep shoulders active and hold for time.

exercises.name: Deadlift (Conventional)
exercises.description: Stand with feet hip-width, bar over mid-foot. Hinge at hips, grip bar, drive through heels to stand. Keep bar close to body.

exercises.name: Decline Bench Press (Barbell)
exercises.description: Lie on a decline bench. Lower bar to lower chest and press up, keeping shoulders retracted.

exercises.name: Decline Dumbbell Press
exercises.description: Lie on a decline bench with dumbbells. Press from lower chest line to above chest, then lower under control.

exercises.name: Decline Push Up
exercises.description: Place feet on a bench and hands on floor. Lower chest, then press up while keeping body straight.

exercises.name: Deep Squat Hold
exercises.description: Sit into a deep squat, keep heels down if possible, and gently open hips with elbows.

exercises.name: Deficit Handstand Push-Up
exercises.description: Perform handstand push-ups from elevated handles for a deeper pressing range.

exercises.name: Deficit Reverse Lunge
exercises.description: Stand on a small platform. Step backward into a deeper lunge, then drive up through front leg.

exercises.name: Depth Jump
exercises.description: Step from a box, land briefly, and jump upward explosively with minimal ground contact.

exercises.name: Depth Push-Up
exercises.description: Drop hands from elevated blocks to the floor and rebound into an explosive push-up.

exercises.name: Diamond Push Up
exercises.description: Form diamond shape with hands under chest. Lower until chest touches hands, focus on tricep engagement. Push up explosively.

exercises.name: Dip
exercises.description: Support body on parallel bars. Lower by bending elbows until shoulders below elbows, then press up. Lean forward to target chest more.

exercises.name: Donkey Calf Raise
exercises.description: Hinge forward with load across hips. Raise heels high, pause, then lower into stretch.

exercises.name: Donkey Kick
exercises.description: Start on all fours. Drive one heel upward by extending hip, squeeze glute, then lower.

exercises.name: Doorway Pec Stretch
exercises.description: Place forearm on doorway and step through gently until chest stretches.

exercises.name: Downward Dog
exercises.description: Press hips upward from plank-like position, pushing chest toward thighs and heels toward floor.

exercises.name: Dragon Flag
exercises.description: Lie on bench holding behind head. Raise body into a straight line and lower slowly.

exercises.name: Drop Jump
exercises.description: Drop from a low box and rebound upward quickly while maintaining a stable landing position.

exercises.name: Duck Walk
exercises.description: Carry a low front-loaded implement between the legs for distance.

exercises.name: Dumbbell Fly
exercises.description: Lie on bench with dumbbells extended above chest. Lower weights in wide arc until chest stretch, then squeeze chest to bring weights together.

exercises.name: Dumbbell Pullover
exercises.description: Lie on a bench holding one dumbbell over chest. Lower weight behind head, then pull back over chest.

exercises.name: Dumbbell Romanian Deadlift
exercises.description: Hold dumbbells in front of thighs. Hinge back until hamstrings stretch, then drive hips forward.

exercises.name: Dumbbell Shrug
exercises.description: Hold dumbbells at sides. Shrug shoulders upward, pause briefly, then lower fully.

exercises.name: Dumbbell Side Bend
exercises.description: Hold dumbbell at one side. Bend sideways slightly, then pull torso back upright.

exercises.name: Dumbbell Snatch
exercises.description: Lift dumbbell from floor to overhead in one explosive motion, then lower and switch sides.

exercises.name: Dumbbell Squat
exercises.description: Hold dumbbells at sides or shoulders. Squat down with control and stand back up.

exercises.name: Dumbbell Thruster
exercises.description: Hold dumbbells at shoulders. Squat down, then stand and press overhead in one motion.

exercises.name: Dumbbell Tricep Kickback
exercises.description: Hinge forward with upper arm beside torso. Extend elbow backward, then lower slowly.

exercises.name: Elliptical
exercises.description: Use elliptical with smooth leg drive and optional handle push-pull rhythm.

exercises.name: Explosive Pull-Up
exercises.description: Pull rapidly so the chest rises high above the bar with control on the descent.

exercises.name: EZ-Bar Curl
exercises.description: Hold EZ-bar with underhand grip. Curl toward shoulders, then lower under control.

exercises.name: Face Pull
exercises.description: Stand facing cable machine at face height. Pull rope to face level, external rotate shoulders. Targets rear delts and rotator cuff.

exercises.name: Farmer Handle Carry
exercises.description: Carry heavy farmer handles for distance while maintaining tall posture and grip.

exercises.name: Farmer's Walk
exercises.description: Carry heavy weights at sides, walk forward maintaining upright posture. Targets grip, core, and traps.

exercises.name: Figure Four Stretch
exercises.description: Lie on back, cross one ankle over opposite knee, and pull legs toward chest.

exercises.name: Fingal’s Fingers
exercises.description: Lift and tip a long hinged implement from the ground to vertical.

exercises.name: Fire Hydrant
exercises.description: Start on all fours. Lift bent knee out to side, pause, then lower while keeping hips stable.

exercises.name: Floor Press (Barbell)
exercises.description: Lie on floor under a barbell. Lower until upper arms touch the floor, then press up.

exercises.name: Floor Press (Dumbbell)
exercises.description: Lie on floor with dumbbells. Lower elbows until upper arms touch floor, then press up.

exercises.name: Flutter Kicks
exercises.description: Lie on back with legs straight. Alternate small up-and-down kicks while keeping lower back down.

exercises.name: Foam Roller Calf Mobilization
exercises.description: Sit with foam roller under calf and roll slowly from ankle toward knee.

exercises.name: Foam Roller Lat Mobilization
exercises.description: Lie on side with foam roller under lat and slowly roll tender areas.

exercises.name: Foam Roller Quad Mobilization
exercises.description: Lie face-down with foam roller under thigh and roll slowly from hip to knee.

exercises.name: Foam Roller Thoracic Extension
exercises.description: Place foam roller under upper back and gently extend over it in small segments.

exercises.name: Forearm Plank
exercises.description: Hold body in a straight line on forearms and toes. Brace abs and avoid sagging hips.

exercises.name: Forward Lunge
exercises.description: Step forward into a lunge, lower until both knees bend, then push back to starting position.

exercises.name: Frame Carry
exercises.description: Carry a loaded frame for distance while keeping shoulders packed and torso braced.

exercises.name: Freestanding Handstand Hold
exercises.description: Balance in a freestanding handstand while keeping elbows locked and ribs controlled.

exercises.name: Frog Pump
exercises.description: Lie on back with soles of feet together and knees out. Pump hips upward while squeezing glutes.

exercises.name: Frog Stretch
exercises.description: Kneel with knees wide and hips back. Hold a gentle inner-thigh stretch.

exercises.name: Front Lever Raise
exercises.description: Raise from a dead hang toward a front lever while keeping the body tight and controlled.

exercises.name: Front Lever Row
exercises.description: Row the chest toward the bar while holding a front lever progression.

exercises.name: Front Rack Carry
exercises.description: Hold kettlebells or dumbbells in front rack at shoulders. Walk while bracing core.

exercises.name: Front Raise (Dumbbell)
exercises.description: Stand with dumbbells in front of thighs. Raise arms to shoulder height, then lower slowly.

exercises.name: Front Raise (Plate)
exercises.description: Hold a weight plate with both hands. Raise to shoulder height, then lower with control.

exercises.name: Front Squat
exercises.description: Bar across front deltoids, elbows high. Squat down keeping torso upright. More quad dominant than back squat.

exercises.name: Full Front Lever Hold
exercises.description: Hold a straight-body front lever with body parallel to the floor.

exercises.name: Full Planche Hold
exercises.description: Hold a full planche with straight arms and body parallel to the floor.

exercises.name: German Hang Pull-Out
exercises.description: Pull from a German hang back toward an inverted or support position with control.

exercises.name: Glute-Ham Raise
exercises.description: Secure feet in glute-ham developer. Lower torso and extend back up using hamstrings and glutes.

exercises.name: Goblet Carry
exercises.description: Hold kettlebell or dumbbell at chest. Walk with ribs down and torso upright.

exercises.name: Goblet Squat
exercises.description: Hold a dumbbell or kettlebell at chest. Squat down between knees, then stand tall.

exercises.name: Good Morning
exercises.description: Place bar on upper back. Hinge at hips with soft knees, then return by squeezing glutes.

exercises.name: Hack Squat
exercises.description: Stand on hack squat platform with shoulders under pads. Lower until knees bend deeply, then press up.

exercises.name: Hammer Curl
exercises.description: Hold dumbbells with neutral grip (palms facing each other). Curl to shoulders, targets brachialis and forearms more than standard curl.

exercises.name: Hamstring Curl (Stability Ball)
exercises.description: Lie on back with heels on ball. Lift hips and curl ball toward body, then extend legs.

exercises.name: Hand-Release Push Up
exercises.description: Lower chest to floor, briefly lift hands, then plant hands and push back up.

exercises.name: Hang Clean
exercises.description: Start with bar above knees. Extend hips explosively and catch bar on shoulders.

exercises.name: Hanging Knee Raise
exercises.description: Hang from bar, bring knees to chest. Lower with control. Easier variation of hanging leg raise.

exercises.name: Hanging Leg Raise
exercises.description: Hang from bar, raise straight legs to 90 degrees or higher. Lower with control. Targets lower abs and hip flexors.

exercises.name: Happy Baby Pose
exercises.description: Lie on back, hold feet or shins, and gently pull knees toward armpits.

exercises.name: Harness Sled Pull
exercises.description: Pull a loaded sled forward using a harness and powerful leg drive.

exercises.name: Hercules Hold
exercises.description: Hold two heavy handles out to the sides against pulling force for time.

exercises.name: High Plank
exercises.description: Hold top of push-up position with hands under shoulders. Brace core and keep body straight.

exercises.name: High-to-Low Cable Fly
exercises.description: Set pulleys high. Pull handles down and together toward lower chest to emphasize lower chest.

exercises.name: Hip Abduction Machine
exercises.description: Sit with pads outside thighs. Push knees outward, pause, then return slowly.

exercises.name: Hip Adduction Machine
exercises.description: Sit with pads outside knees. Squeeze thighs together, then return slowly.

exercises.name: Hip Thrust
exercises.description: Upper back against bench, bar across hips. Drive hips up until body forms straight line. Squeeze glutes at top, lower with control.

exercises.name: Hollow Body Hold
exercises.description: Lie on back with arms and legs extended off floor. Press lower back down and hold.

exercises.name: Human Flag Hold
exercises.description: Hold the body sideways from a vertical pole with stacked hands and full-body tension.

exercises.name: Human Flag Raise
exercises.description: Raise and lower the body into a human flag progression with controlled side-body tension.

exercises.name: Hurdle Hop
exercises.description: Hop over low hurdles in sequence with quick, elastic ground contact.

exercises.name: Husafell Stone Carry
exercises.description: Bear-hug carry a shield-shaped stone for distance with strong trunk bracing.

exercises.name: Ice Cream Maker
exercises.description: Move between a pull-up top position and a front lever position under control.

exercises.name: Inchworm Walkout
exercises.description: Hinge down, walk hands to plank, then walk feet toward hands or reverse.

exercises.name: Incline Bench Press (Barbell)
exercises.description: Set bench to an incline. Lower bar to upper chest, then press up while keeping wrists stacked over elbows.

exercises.name: Incline Dumbbell Curl
exercises.description: Sit on an incline bench with arms hanging. Curl dumbbells without swinging, then lower fully.

exercises.name: Incline Dumbbell Press
exercises.description: Set bench to 30-45° incline. Press dumbbells from chest level to full extension above shoulders. Control the eccentric phase.

exercises.name: Incline Push Up
exercises.description: Place hands on a bench or box. Lower chest toward the surface, then push back up.

exercises.name: Incline Treadmill Walk
exercises.description: Walk on treadmill at an incline while keeping posture tall and steps controlled.

exercises.name: Inverted Row
exercises.description: Lie under a fixed bar. Pull chest to bar while keeping body straight, then lower with control.

exercises.name: Iron Cross Progression Hold
exercises.description: Hold an assisted iron cross progression with arms wide and shoulders stabilized.

exercises.name: JM Press
exercises.description: Lower bar toward upper chest/neck with elbows forward, then extend elbows to press back up.

exercises.name: Jump Lunge
exercises.description: Switch legs in the air from a lunge position and land with control.

exercises.name: Jump Rope
exercises.description: Jump repeatedly over rope with light foot contacts and steady rhythm.

exercises.name: Keg Carry
exercises.description: Carry a keg against the torso or on the shoulder for distance.

exercises.name: Keg Load
exercises.description: Lift a keg from the floor and load it to a platform or over a bar.

exercises.name: Kettlebell Clean
exercises.description: Swing kettlebell from hinge and guide it into front rack position, then lower and repeat.

exercises.name: Kettlebell Snatch
exercises.description: Swing kettlebell overhead in one motion, finishing with arm locked out and shoulder stable.

exercises.name: Kettlebell Swing
exercises.description: Hinge kettlebell between legs, then snap hips forward to swing it to chest height.

exercises.name: Kipping Handstand Push-Up
exercises.description: Use hip drive to assist the press from a handstand push-up position.

exercises.name: Kipping Muscle-Up
exercises.description: Use coordinated hip drive to assist the pull and transition over the bar or rings.

exercises.name: Kneeling Hip Flexor Stretch
exercises.description: Kneel in lunge position, tuck pelvis slightly, and shift forward until front of hip stretches.

exercises.name: Kneeling Jump
exercises.description: Start from tall kneeling and explosively jump to a squat landing.

exercises.name: L-Sit
exercises.description: Support body on parallel bars or floor. Lift legs to form L shape, hold position. Requires strong core and hip flexors.

exercises.name: L-Sit Hold
exercises.description: Hold the body supported on hands with legs straight in front and hips lifted.

exercises.name: Landmine Press
exercises.description: Hold the end of a landmine bar at shoulder height. Press forward and upward, then lower with control.

exercises.name: Landmine Row
exercises.description: Straddle a landmine bar with row handle. Pull bar toward torso, then lower under control.

exercises.name: Landmine Squat
exercises.description: Hold landmine bar at chest. Squat down with upright torso, then stand and keep bar close.

exercises.name: Lat Pulldown
exercises.description: Seated at lat pulldown machine. Pull bar to upper chest, squeeze lats at bottom. Control the eccentric phase fully.

exercises.name: Lat Stretch on Bench
exercises.description: Kneel facing bench with elbows on bench. Sit hips back until lats stretch.

exercises.name: Lateral Bound
exercises.description: Jump side to side from one leg to the other with strong lateral hip control.

exercises.name: Lateral Box Jump
exercises.description: Jump sideways onto a box and land with hips and knees stable.

exercises.name: Lateral Hurdle Hop
exercises.description: Hop side to side over a hurdle while maintaining quick rebound mechanics.

exercises.name: Lateral Lunge
